_comment: Each bucket can match terms three ways (apply in order; OR-combined within a bucket):
parentSubtreeUris — ontology parent URIs; expanded via OntologyService.getChildren
(CHEBI must be loaded for these to populate; otherwise 0).
Bucket order is first-match-wins: a term that's both a drug AND a hormone lands
other_chemical   — CHEBI URIs not in any explicit bucket.
other            — non-CHEBI URIs not in any explicit bucket.
To override: drop a treatment-buckets.json into ${gemma.appdata.home}/HomeStats/.
If present it replaces this classpath default. Otherwise this file ships.

buckets._comment: Vehicles / solvent controls. Listed FIRST so e.g. DMSO matches `vehicle` before falling through into the broader CHEBI:23888 'drug' subtree under `approved_drug`. The UI can hide this bucket from the bar chart — it's not pharmacology data, but worth classifying so curators can see what's there.
buckets.label: Vehicles / solvents
